propositions: Eight Jira modules currently at package root must be relocated under adapters/jira/ per ADR 0035, but adf.py, outbound_fields.py, and comment_limits.py are location-pinned and will break the lazy loader unless it is taught their new subpackage path atomically.

The lazy_load() mechanism resolves module paths relative to _PACKAGE_DIR; three modules require relative subpath arguments (adapters/jira/adf.py, adapters/jira/comment_limits.py) to load from the new location without re-export shims.

All surviving references across dotted imports, sibling-path loads, and test path constants must be repointed atomically: jira_fields.py (two adf/comment_limits imports), inbound_fields.py (sibling path to adf), acli.py/acli_cli_ops.py (adf imports), and ~18 test files (categories 2 and 3).

The move preserves path-agnostic object-level test patches (~23 files using patch.object on _load_acli) but requires rewriting ~18 test files that hardcode path constants or dotted imports referencing the moved modules.

No re-export shim may remain at old root paths and no behavior changes occur; the change is purely structural—move files, teach loader via relative subpaths, repoint all references, and verify zero old-path references remain (excluding path-agnostic patches).
